q-38665-before.json.problem:
$$
P=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1\end{bmatrix},\,B=\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 5 \\ 0 & -5 & -2\end{bmatrix}
$$

Consider the nonsingular matrix $P$ and the block diagonal matrix $B$ shown above, where the $2\times 2$ block of $B$ is a rotation-scaling matrix.
Given that $A=PB{P}^{-1},$ what are the complex (not real) eigenvalues and the corresponding eigenvectors of $A?$

q-38665-after.json.problem:
$$
P=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1\end{bmatrix},\,B=\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 5 \\ 0 & -5 & -2\end{bmatrix}
$$

Consider the nonsingular matrix $P$ and the block diagonal matrix $B$ shown above, where the $2\times 2$ block of $B$ is a rotation-scaling matrix.
Given that $A=PB{P}^{-1},$ what are the complex (not real) eigenvalues and the corresponding eigenvectors of $A?$
q-38665-after.json.worked_solution:
Recall that if $A$ is a $3\times 3$ real matrix that has one real eigenvalue ${\color{red}{\lambda }_{1}}$ with corresponding eigenvector ${\color{red}{v}_{1},}$ and two complex eigenvalues ${\color{blue}{\lambda }_{2}}={\overset{―}{{\color{blue}\lambda }}}_{{\color{blue}3}}$ with corresponding eigenvectors ${\color{blue}{v}_{2}}={\overset{―}{{\color{blue}v}}}_{{\color{blue}3}},$ then $A=PB{P}^{-1},$ where

$$
B=\left[\begin{array}{c|cc}{\color{red}{\lambda }_{1}} & 0 & 0 \\ \hline 0 & {\color{blue}\text{Re}({\lambda }_{2})} & {\color{blue}\text{Im}({\lambda }_{2})} \\ 0 & {\color{blue}-\text{Im}({\lambda }_{2})} & {\color{blue}\text{Re}({\lambda }_{2})}\end{array}\right],\,\,P=\begin{bmatrix}{\color{red}|} & {\color{blue}|} & {\color{blue}|} \\ {\color{red}{v}_{1}} & {\color{blue}\text{Re}({v}_{2})} & {\color{blue}\text{Im}({v}_{2})} \\ {\color{red}|} & {\color{blue}|} & {\color{blue}|}\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Notice that swapping the blocks on the main diagonal of $B$ will result in switching the corresponding columns in $P.$

- From our block diagonal matrix

$$
B=\left[\begin{array}{c|cc}{\color{red}-7} & 0 & 0 \\ \hline 0 & {\color{blue}-2} & {\color{blue}5} \\ 0 & {\color{blue}-5} & {\color{blue}-2}\end{array}\right],
$$

we deduce the complex eigenvalues are ${\color{blue}{\lambda }_{2,3}=-2\pm 5\text{i}}$ and the real eigenvalue is ${\color{red}{\lambda }_{1}=-7}.$

- From our matrix

$$
P=\begin{bmatrix}{\color{red}1} & {\color{blue}-2} & {\color{blue}0} \\ {\color{red}5} & {\color{blue}0} & {\color{blue}-2} \\ {\color{red}0} & {\color{blue}1} & {\color{blue}-1}\end{bmatrix},
$$

we deduce that the complex and real eigenvectors are

$$
{v}_{2,3}=\begin{bmatrix}{\color{blue}-2} \\ {\color{blue}∓2\text{i}} \\ {\color{blue}1∓\text{i}}\end{bmatrix},\,{v}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}{\color{red}1} \\ {\color{red}5} \\ {\color{red}0}\end{bmatrix}.
$$
